summary: ICON plc filed a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 earnings press release. The release reports revenue of $2,063.5 million, adjusted net income of $198.4 million ($2.56 adjusted diluted EPS), and reaffirms full-year guidance. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer disclosed via Form 6-K, equivalent to a domestic earnings press release.
